name: Modern Minimalist Hanging Light
desc: A modern minimalist pendant light with a slim suspension cable, compact round ceiling canopy, gold-tone metallic frame, and a softly rounded cylindrical shade. Designed as a decorative accent light for contemporary residential interiors.

specifications.Finish: Gold-tone metallic frame with warm peach / amber-toned shade
